name: Build and maintain a targeted media list for a launch or story
what: Search public journalist and outlet information to build a verified, beat-matched media list for a specific story or launch, so PR outreach targets the right people instead of a generic blast.

Pull public contact routes (bylines, outlet contact pages, social handles) since no paid database is used

Flag contacts who already covered the category or a named competitor recently
Note the preferred pitch format and timing pattern from each outlet's past coverage
Keep the list as a dated, versioned file so repeat pitches do not go stale
Exclude contacts who have unsubscribed or asked not to be pitched
outputs: tiered media list with contact rationale per name, dated
trigger: on demand, before a launch or news moment
founder_sees: Kevin sees a short list of named journalists and outlets matched to the specific story, with why each one fits, instead of a mass email blast.
today_done_by: agency or freelancer

name: Monitor for brand reputation risk and draft crisis holding statements

Draft the internal escalation note: what happened, what is confirmed, what is not, who needs to see it now
Never publish or reply publicly without founder approval
Log the incident and the founder's chosen response for the next audit
Flag when legal review is needed before any public statement

Diff each page against its last capture and keep only material changes
Watch competitor job postings for signals of a new market, channel or capability
Watch competitor ad libraries for new claims or offers, as signal only, never copied
Score each change by relevance to the brand's own bottleneck, not by volume
